  1. Madeleine Albright was a refugee twice before she was twelve — from Hitler, then from Stalin. source

  11. On 23 January 1997 she was sworn in as the sixty-fourth Secretary of State — the first woman to hold the job. source

  16. On 12 March 1999, at the Truman Library in Independence, Missouri, she received the documents that made the Czech Republic, Hungary and Poland members of NATO. source
  17. The country she had fled as a child was now an ally of the country that had taken her in. source
  18. If you moved to a new country, what would help you feel that you belonged there, and did not just live there?
